title: Battery pack thermal control system for electric vehicles
abstract: A battery pack thermal control system monitors module-level temperature signals and dynamically adjusts coolant flow to reduce thermal gradients during high-rate charging.
claims: 1. A battery thermal control system comprising a plurality of temperature sensors coupled to battery modules, a coolant valve assembly, and a controller configured to adjust coolant flow based on predicted temperature gradients. 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the controller reduces charging current when a threshold temperature is exceeded.
description: The invention relates to thermal management of electric vehicle battery packs. Conventional systems use passive heat sinks or fixed-flow cooling. The disclosed controller predicts temperature rise across modules and changes coolant distribution before an unsafe gradient occurs.

title: Liquid cooling plate for high-density battery modules
abstract: A liquid cooling plate includes branching microchannels positioned between pouch cells to increase heat transfer uniformity in compact battery modules.
claims: 1. A cooling plate for a battery module comprising a first manifold, a second manifold, and a plurality of branching coolant channels arranged between adjacent pouch cells. 2. The cooling plate of claim 1, wherein channel width varies according to expected heat generation zones.
description: The disclosed cooling plate improves heat extraction while reducing packaging thickness. The geometry is suitable for high-density electric vehicle battery modules and stationary storage systems.

title: Predictive maintenance platform for industrial robots
abstract: A predictive maintenance platform receives vibration, torque, and thermal sensor streams from industrial robots and uses anomaly scoring to forecast component failure.
claims: 1. A computer-implemented method comprising receiving robot telemetry, generating an anomaly score, and scheduling maintenance when the anomaly score exceeds a learned threshold.
description: The method supports production lines with heterogeneous robot fleets. The platform generates maintenance windows based on failure probability and production constraints.

title: Privacy-preserving health monitoring wearable
abstract: A wearable device processes biometric signals locally and transmits only privacy-preserving event summaries to a remote care platform.
claims: 1. A wearable health monitoring device comprising a biometric sensor, an on-device inference module, and a communication module configured to transmit event summaries without raw biometric waveforms.
description: The system reduces bandwidth and improves privacy by keeping sensitive raw data on the device. Event summaries include confidence scores and time windows.

title: Adaptive charging station with grid-aware load balancing
abstract: An electric vehicle charging station coordinates vehicle charging sessions according to grid capacity, electricity price, and battery thermal state.
claims: 1. A charging station controller configured to allocate charging power across multiple vehicles based on grid capacity data, pricing data, and battery thermal state received from each vehicle.
description: The invention improves charging infrastructure utilization while reducing grid stress. The controller may slow charging for batteries with elevated temperature.
